custom_spell_creation_rules.title: ACKS Players Companion Custom Spell Rules

scope.rule: This summary preserves only reusable spell-construction mechanics and excludes named example spells used for illustration.

power_guidelines.rule: These guidelines are used to assign spell level to newly created spells.
Without breakthroughs through experimentation, new spells built with these guidelines are generally confined to more mundane levels of spell power than the most exceptional existing spells.
Replicating unusually powerful benchmark spells requires breakthroughs through experimentation.

determining_spell_level.rule: To preserve the ACKS feel of magic, damaging spells should be restricted to odd spell levels.
Each spell level spans 10 spell points.
1st level spells cost 1-10 spell points, 2nd level spells cost 11-20 spell points, and so on.
A spell's spell points are calculated from its type, effect cost, target factor, duration factor, range factor, saving throw factor, and source factor.
determining_spell_level.derived_rule: Spell level can be derived as the 10-point band containing the final spell point total.

type.name: blast
type.summary: Deals damage or detrimental effects to individual targets or areas by evoking a medium such as arcane force, fire, or toxic gas.
type.distinction: Damage dealt directly through magic is a death spell instead of a blast spell.
type.interaction: Blast spells with an elemental component benefit from Elementalism proficiency.

type.name: death
type.summary: Deals damage or detrimental effects directly and uses necromantic energy, including life draining and animating the dead.
type.interaction: Death spells usually require saves versus death to avoid their effects and therefore benefit from Secrets of the Dark Arts or Black Lore of Zahar.
If a death spell involves necromantic potence, level draining, or undead, it counts as necromantic for Secrets of the Dark Arts and Black Lore of Zahar.

type.name: detection
type.summary: Detects categories of creatures, powers, or objects within range.
type.interaction: Detection spells are not modified by a specific class power or proficiency unless the Judge creates one.

type.name: enchantment
type.summary: Charms, commands, holds, mesmerizes, or otherwise affects the will of target creatures.
type.interaction: Mastery of Charms and Illusions applies to all enchantment spells.

type.name: healing
type.summary: Regenerates, revitalizes, reincarnates, or resurrects creatures.
type.interaction: Healing spells may be reversed to damage or kill, in which case they function like weak death spells.
Reversed healing spells that require a save versus death benefit from Secrets of the Dark Arts or Black Lore of Zahar.

type.name: illusion
type.summary: Creates phantasmal images and sounds, conceals or manipulates light and motion, and manufactures figments of the imagination.
type.distinction: Illusions do not directly affect target consciousness; enchantments do.
type.interaction: Mastery of Charms and Illusions applies to all illusion spells.

type.name: movement
type.summary: Moves creatures directly through magical power or allows them to move by magical power.
type.distinction: A spell that grants movement by giving the target the characteristics of another creature is a transmogrification spell instead.

type.name: protection
type.summary: Enhances armor class and saving throws, wards off foes, and directly protects against spells, weapons, and elements.
type.distinction: A spell that protects by giving the target the characteristics of another creature is a transmogrification spell instead.
type.interaction: Protection spells are not modified by a specific class power or proficiency unless the Judge creates one.

type.name: summoning
type.summary: Calls creatures from elsewhere to serve the spellcaster.
type.interaction: Summoning spells that call creatures from the elemental planes benefit from Elementalism proficiency.
The Judge may create class powers or proficiencies for summoning specialization.

type.name: transmogrification
type.summary: Transforms the physical and or mental characteristics of creatures or objects, either completely or partially.
type.interaction: Transmogrification spells benefit from the Transmogrification proficiency.
Some transmogrification spells with an elemental component, usually stone, benefit from Elementalism proficiency.

type.name: wall
type.summary: Creates barriers of physical, elemental, or magical substance.
type.distinction: Wall spells use energies similar to blast spells but emphasize malleable or mobile areas of effect with long duration.
type.interaction: Wall spells with an elemental component benefit from Elementalism proficiency.
Unusual wall spells may benefit from other proficiencies when their substance or effect matches that specialty; undead-based walls benefit from Secrets of the Black Arts and Black Lore of Zahar.

component.name: effect_cost
component.rule: Each effect has a base cost in spell points.
Effect modifiers multiply the base cost.
When a spell has multiple effects and only some are modified, apply modifiers to each effect separately and then sum the totals.

component.name: target_factor
component.rule: Targets are generally creatures or areas.
An area-targeted spell affects all creatures and objects in the area unless it has a selective targeting modifier.
A creature-targeted spell lets the caster choose the affected creatures unless a targeting modifier prevents that choice.
Spells that affect more creatures or larger areas have higher target factors.

component.name: range_factor
component.rule: Longer ranges cost more spell points.
Range 0' means the caster must be close enough to touch the target.
A spell with range 0' does not require an attack throw unless attack throw required is selected as a targeting modifier.
A range 0' spell that requires an attack throw is designated as touch range.

component.name: duration_factor
component.rule: Longer durations cost more spell points.
component.definition: The spell's energy comes and goes the instant the spell is cast, though consequences may last.
The spell lasts until dispelled or otherwise canceled.

component.name: saving_throw_factor
component.rule: Spells with no saving throw have higher saving throw factors.
Spells entirely avoided with a saving throw have lower saving throw factors.
Spells partly avoided with a saving throw use intermediate saving throw factors.
Spells with only beneficial effects always use a saving throw factor of 1.

component.name: source_factor
component.rule: A spell's source is arcane or divine.
Source factor depends on both spell type and source.

build_procedure.step: Consult that type's spell characteristics tables.
Choose the spell's effect or effects.
Choose the spell's target or targets.
Multiply total effect cost by target factor, duration factor, range factor, saving throw factor, and source factor.
Round the final spell point total to the nearest whole number.

rounding_rule.rule: Round the final spell point total to the nearest whole number.
When the fractional value is exactly .5, round down if the preceding whole number is even and round up if it is odd.

notes.rule: All damaging blast spells deal variable damage based on caster level.
To create a fixed-damage blast spell, select an appropriate variable damage effect and apply a maximum damage modifier equal to or lower than the caster level required to cast the spell.
